note: #310: the unit_class downgrade through the channel the gate TRUSTS. Not a duplicate of downgraded-class-1: that trap puts unit_class=report-only inside the manifest, which verify.py never reads, so it fail-safes to mutation. This one supplies it the way the gate actually takes it -- --unit-class, which verify-gate.sh fills from ORCA_UNIT_CLASS. unit_class reaches the native in-session gate through ORCA_UNIT_CLASS, which the worker owns, so a unit that changed production code declares itself report-only and sheds the negative control, the intent packet, lighting legality and reviewer_mode in one value. This is the same run-time fixture the mutation controls use, so base_sha..head_sha really does change mod.py -- everything about the manifest is honest for a report-only unit EXCEPT that the work it describes mutated behaviour. The RED must come from the class claim being measured against the change, not from a missing field: a report-only unit is not required to carry any of the obligations this one dropped.
